title: The Riff That Learned to Breathe
logline: A mechanical riff travels between two fictional adult creators, learns to breathe as downtempo music, and returns with a new body but the same heart.
visualIdentity: An original hand-drawn anime world made of watercolor rain, gouache shadows, fine ink lines, paper fibers, brushed metal, and restrained 2.5D parallax. It feels intimate and authored rather than glossy or synthetic.
narrativeTheme: the main riff as a durable heart
the solo as an expressive amber ribbon
tempo change as learning to breathe

characters.description: The Architect, one consistent fictional adult with wavy dark hair, warm brown eyes, a rust-colored work jacket over a charcoal shirt, practical dark trousers, calm precise hands, no jewelry, no logos
The Listener, one consistent fictional adult with short dark hair and one silver forelock, an indigo overshirt, a muted amber scarf, charcoal trousers, observant eyes, no jewelry, no logos

heroProp.description: the same palm-sized origami bird, initially made from brushed dark metal and guitar-string-like ribs, with a small warm amber mechanical heart visible through its chest; later its feathers become layered paper and fabric while the amber heart and exact silhouette remain unchanged
